huo15-influencer-video 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Lets users create and export polished influencer videos in 1–2 minutes from raw clips, with features like cutting filler words, branded captions, and background music sync.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM formats; optimized for TikTok and Instagram influencers.
- Includes automatic cloud backend setup and session management, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Exposes user-friendly commands for uploading, editing, checking credits/status, and exporting 1080p MP4s.
- Handles common errors, backend instructions, and summarizes timeline edits for a streamlined editing experience without pro-level tools.
